nodes.label: Analytics Tab 4: Genres & Regions (audience breakdown)

nodes.label: Analytics Tab 5: Station Health (uptime, status grid)

nodes.label: useFavorites Hook (localStorage + API sync)
nodes.rationale: Favorites sync to the backend when the user is authenticated and fall back to localStorage for guests, so favorites persist across refresh in both states.

nodes.label: StationAvatar Component
nodes.rationale: Shows station logo image when available, falls back to a coloured circle with the station's initials to avoid broken-image states.

nodes.label: Auto-Reconnect with Exponential Backoff
nodes.rationale: When a stream drops, retry with exponential backoff 2s to 4s to 8s to 16s capped at 30s, max 5 attempts, instead of stopping at the first error; attempts reset on successful play.

nodes.label: Icecast Metadata Proxy Route
nodes.rationale: Next.js API route /api/stream-metadata fetches the Icecast status-json.xsl endpoint server-side to sidestep CORS; only works for Icecast streams, Shoutcast/HLS silently return null (graceful fallback).

nodes.label: PWA Support via next-pwa
nodes.rationale: Service worker disabled in development (disable: NODE_ENV === 'development') so PWA must be tested with a production build.

nodes.label: Heartbeat Session System
nodes.rationale: Each browser session gets a UUID persisted in localStorage; a 30-second client heartbeat keeps the session alive while a MongoDB TTL index of 45s on lastHeartbeat auto-expires sessions that go silent, so no server-side cleanup job is needed.

nodes.label: MongoDB Client Singleton (lib/mongodb.ts)
nodes.rationale: A single MongoClient cached on globalThis in development is shared across all Next.js API routes for hot-reload safety, avoiding connection exhaustion.

nodes.label: Play Event Pipeline (title-change detection)
nodes.rationale: The client hook compares the previous title ref to the new one; on change it PATCHes the previous play's endedAt closed, then POSTs a new play event. playDuration is computed server-side from endedAt minus detectedAt.

nodes.label: SnapshotDocument (stationSnapshots collection)
nodes.rationale: Fire-and-forget station health snapshots written on every metadata poll, capturing isOnline, listeners and metadata source for uptime monitoring.

nodes.label: TTL Auto-Purge Indexes
nodes.rationale: TTL indexes auto-delete plays older than 90 days and snapshots older than 30 days so unbounded write volume never requires manual cleanup.

nodes.label: Smart End-of-Song Poll Scheduler
nodes.rationale: Zetta stations (Capital FM, Kiss 100, Classic 105) expose startTime + durationSeconds, so a one-shot setTimeout is armed to fire 2s after the predicted song end instead of waiting up to 15s for the flat interval; the 15s interval remains as fallback for stations without timing data. Guard rails: skip if remaining <= 2s (already ended) or > 10 min (stale data); cancelled on URL change, title change, and unmount.

nodes.label: useKeyboardShortcuts Hook (11 shortcuts)
nodes.rationale: One document-level keydown listener registered at ModernAirwave level handles all 11 shortcuts and returns the ShortcutDef array consumed by the cheatsheet, avoiding scattered per-component listeners.

nodes.label: ShortcutCheatsheet Modal
nodes.rationale: Built from scratch rather than reusing the existing light-mode-only Modal.tsx so it uses CSS variables and respects dark mode; includes focus trap, aria-modal, and motion-safe animations.

nodes.label: HttpOnly Cookie JWT Delivery
nodes.rationale: Migrating tokens from localStorage to HttpOnly cookies removes XSS token theft exposure; refresh cookie path is restricted to /api/auth/refresh and the refresh endpoint rotates both tokens. JWT_COOKIE_SECURE is gated on FLASK_ENV so local http dev still works.

nodes.label: fetchWithRefresh Wrapper
nodes.rationale: Transparently retries a request once after a 401 by calling the refresh endpoint; if refresh fails it dispatches a window 'auth:expired' event that AuthContext listens for to clear the user.

nodes.label: Next.js Sliding-Window Rate Limiter (middleware.ts)
nodes.rationale: In-memory Map keyed by ip:pathname enforces per-route sliding-window limits before handlers run; suitable for single-instance deployment, swappable for Upstash Redis for multi-instance.

nodes.label: Station Type Consolidation
nodes.rationale: types/Station.ts becomes the single source of truth; the duplicate diverged interface in lib/api.ts is replaced with a re-export and legacy camelCase fields (listeners, isLive, logo) are removed to end silent type unsafety.

nodes.label: useStations Wiring (replace mock data)
nodes.rationale: MordernAirwave switches from 18 hardcoded stations in lib/stations.ts to the useStations hook fetching the Flask API, passing real loading/error state to StationGrid; lib/stations.ts is deleted.

nodes.label: Counters Collection (auto-increment integer IDs)
nodes.rationale: A counters collection with atomic find_one_and_update $inc preserves integer IDs through the SQLite-to-MongoDB migration so the frontend and existing analytics collections need zero changes.

nodes.label: Plain Python Model Classes (no ORM)
nodes.rationale: User and Station become plain wrapper classes over MongoDB documents, removing Flask-SQLAlchemy/Migrate/alembic entirely; favorites are embedded as a favorite_station_ids int array on user documents instead of a join table.

nodes.label: Flask analytics_bp (MongoDB aggregations)
nodes.rationale: SQLAlchemy queries are replaced with MongoDB aggregation pipelines while keeping route signatures identical so no frontend changes are needed.

nodes.label: Flask Deep Health Check
nodes.rationale: Health endpoint gains per-component status checks (SELECT 1 database probe) and returns 503 when degraded instead of a static healthy response.

nodes.label: Next.js /api/health Aggregation Route
nodes.rationale: Proxies the Flask health endpoint and independently pings MongoDB, merging both into one status payload with namespaced backend.* check keys.

nodes.label: Next.js Error Boundaries (error.tsx + global-error.tsx)
nodes.rationale: Route-segment and root error boundaries give users a graceful recovery UI with a reset button instead of a blank crash; global-error must render its own html/body tree.

nodes.label: Cache-Control on Stations Endpoint
nodes.rationale: public, max-age=30, stale-while-revalidate=60 lets CDNs and reverse proxies cache the stations list that every client requests on page load, reducing backend load.

nodes.label: useStations In-Memory SWR Cache
nodes.rationale: A module-level 60s TTL cache prevents redundant getStations fetches on remount (hot reload, StrictMode double-mount); only unfiltered page-1 responses are cached.

nodes.label: Skeleton Card Loading State (StationGrid)
nodes.rationale: Skeleton placeholders matching the real card layout replace the generic spinner for better perceived performance and no layout shift.

nodes.label: App Engagement Rate Metric
nodes.rationale: stationPlays click count divided by total stream listener sum times 100 — the only metric crossing both collections, answering what fraction of broadcast listeners also use the Airwave app.

nodes.label: LiveStatusBar (15s polling)
nodes.rationale: Persistent bar above tab nav polls Flask /analytics/real-time every 15s; on error it silently keeps stale values so the bar never shows a broken state.

nodes.label: Chart Components (LineChart, DonutChart, HBarChart, HeatmapGrid)
nodes.rationale: Recharts v2 handles standard charts; the 24h-by-7-day heatmap is custom SVG because Recharts has no equivalent.

nodes.label: TrendingStrip Component
nodes.rationale: Receives the already-fetched stations array from MordernAirwave and matches trending IDs to full Station objects for playback, avoiding a redundant fetch; renders null on error or empty response so the strip disappears cleanly.

nodes.label: Composite Trending Score
nodes.rationale: score = 0.5 * normalized live listeners + 0.3 * normalized growth + 0.2 * normalized plays today; growth_pct is omitted when plays_yesterday is 0 to avoid misleading infinity values.

nodes.label: Input Focus Guard
nodes.rationale: Before handling any shortcut except Escape and /, check document.activeElement; bail out for INPUT/TEXTAREA/SELECT so typing in search never triggers playback shortcuts. Escape priority: cheatsheet close beats search clear.

nodes.label: Cookie Token Flow with Silent Refresh & Rotation
nodes.rationale: Cross-domain deployment requires SameSite=None; Secure cookies. Access 24h / refresh 30d; on 401 the client silently refreshes (rotation issues both new cookies) and retries once; refresh failure dispatches auth:expired. Concurrent 401s are safe because cookies overwrite idempotently. Existing localStorage sessions log out cleanly on deploy with no migration.

nodes.label: Architecture Refactoring Design Spec
nodes.rationale: Three blocking problems: broken Airwave.tsx prototype importing a non-existent module, duplicate diverged Station types, and hardcoded mock stations bypassing the backend API so the UI never shows real data.

nodes.label: Dual Collections: plays vs stationPlays
nodes.rationale: plays (camelCase, written by Next.js song detection, 90 days of broadcast stream data) and stationPlays (snake_case, written by Flask on user click, new and sparse) tell complementary stories; the Audience tab is powered exclusively by plays while existing tabs keep stationPlays, so neither pipeline is disturbed.

nodes.label: URL-Synced Tab & Period State
nodes.rationale: ?tab= and ?period= live in the URL via useSearchParams + router.replace so dashboard views are deep-linkable and survive refresh; drill-down is a modal rather than a route to avoid back-navigation complexity.
